files.title: Attention-based neural networks for protein structure prediction
files.abstract: We propose an attention-based neural network for protein structure prediction, trained on 12,000 curated structures. The deep learning model improves TM-score by 0.08 over prior baselines. Code and weights are released for reproducibility.

files.title: Attention-based neural networks for protein structure prediction (preprint v1)
files.abstract: Preprint v1 of the protein structure prediction study: we propose an attention-based neural network for protein structure prediction trained on 12,000 curated structures.

files.title: Hippocampal replay and spatial memory consolidation during sleep
files.abstract: We record hippocampal replay in sleeping rats and relate replay events to spatial memory accuracy. Results link sleep replay to memory consolidation.

files.title: A survey of machine learning methods in climate science
files.abstract: A survey of machine learning methods applied to climate science, covering emulation, downscaling and parameterization. We discuss open challenges in climate modeling.

files.title: Dataset: Global sea surface temperature reanalysis v2 (1980-2020)
files.abstract: Gridded global sea surface temperature reanalysis product v2, monthly means from 1980 to 2020, 0.25 degree resolution.

files.title: Reward shaping in multi-agent reinforcement learning for urban traffic signal control
files.abstract: We study reward shaping in multi-agent reinforcement learning for urban traffic signal control across three cities. Shaped agents converge faster and reduce average waiting time by 12%.
